description: Token safety check before you trade: rug-pull and scam risk for an ERC20 on Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum or Optimism, from the deployed bytecode and live state. Detects mint, pause, blacklist, upgradeable proxy and mutable buy/sell tax powers, and whether ownership is renounced. Each finding carries its evidence: the exact selector and byte offset. Static check, no buy/sell simulation. Deterministic: same contract, same answer. $0.01 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_token_safety
title: ERC20 pre-trade safety check
